title: Self-hosted
summary: The server bundle defaults to yoke-server under the machine home (~/.yoke or YOKE_MACHINE_HOME), independent of the project or invoking directory; --dir selects an explicit location. Uninstall discovers bundles through Docker Compose labels. Loopback remains the default. self-host init --listen publishes a numeric LAN, Tailscale or wildcard bind through YOKE_API_PUBLISH. Connect permits declared private-network HTTP and *.ts.net with a warning on every command; public HTTP requires HTTPS.
